question: Two triangles PRS and DEF are similar whose perimeters are 36 cm and 40 cm, respectively. If length of DE is 10 cm, then what is the length (in cm) of PR?
solution:
**Given:**

△PRS ∼ △DEF

Perimeter of △PRS = 36 cm

Perimeter of △DEF = 40 cm

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of △₁/Perimeter of △₂ = side of △1/side of △2

**Calculation:**

Perimeter of △PRS/Perimeter of △DEF = side of △PRS/side of △DEF

⇒ 36/40 = PR/DE

⇒ 36/40 = PR/10

⇒ PR = (36 × 10)/40

⇒ PR = 9 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 9 cm.**
